architecture: Real Student HTTP -> local Nginx post-response Unix syslog -> bounded RAM-only worker -> frozen RIv2 -> metadata journal -> existing Rust ingestion/DB -> existing Security dashboard; AI enforcement disabled

verified_live_acceptance.Student_auth_DB_workflow: See foundation smoke-report.json: CSRF/login/me + paired Nginx/Student audit
limitations: Same-host local small sample, not a quality/throughput benchmark
Local lossy bounded datagrams; no durable raw HTTP replay

foundation_smoke.suricata: fixture source only; no live capture launched

quality_limits: Six safe real HTTP queries to CSRF endpoint, not exploit successes or independent evaluation. No Recall/FPR/precision claim.
URI and selected header text only, body missing, fixed header serialization may shift representations.
Command-shaped query remained below frozen threshold; no threshold tuning.
An initial integration run wrote six INFERENCE_ERROR events due to dict/string header mismatch; retained and fixed in adapter.
A separate early run lost its first datagram after socket replacement; retained as evidence of lossy transport.
Observed cold first score in early corrected run was2240.21ms; reported final small batch is warmed.
No live Suricata packet capture or GLU207 flow bridge.

thermal.note: Build-only pause mode preserves compiler state; global host temperature can exceed80 while own cgroup frozen. AI mode still kills at threshold; control errors fail closed. All stopped/error runs are retained.

GLU_blockers: Missing live correlated Suricata flow/bytes/history bridge with full frozen207-feature semantics and parity; no zero padding
AWS_remaining: Stable target thermal/resource environment and service supervision
Authorized post-TLS telemetry vantage/feature availability policy
Transport loss accounting and durable bounded metadata delivery/retention sizing
Service identity, permissions, secrets and target load/latency tests
Live Suricata/GLU contract bridge if required
Independent model detection validation belongs to a separate milestone

latency_all_retained_scores.scope: Wall around predictor.predict includes cgroup suspension/throttling/cold imports; excludes queue wait and DB/UI transit. Not a pure compute benchmark.

filtered_AI_results.quality_scope: Research score, not attack probability or Ground Truth

runtime_supervision_note: Host may overheat from external load; worker may be paused, stopped or stale after a functional PASS. Read final_runtime_snapshot, do not infer current availability from previous scores.

security_check.scope: Heuristic scan of changed public-intended text, not a general absence-of-secrets guarantee. Private runtime/credentials/evidence remain ignored.

readiness_scope: Small local shadow demo functionally verified; not continuous availability under externally induced host overheating, production detection quality or AWS readiness.
runtime_left_running: two existing local PostgreSQL dev containers
